design_archetype: Modern Dark-Mode Tactical Arcade (Obsidian Slate + Cyan & Amber Neon Energy)
summary: High-octane 60fps HTML5 Canvas Roguelike Tower Defense RPG with tactical cyber-fantasy aesthetic. Dark obsidian-zinc foundations with luminous cyan plasma, energized amber gold, and laser ruby accents. Crystal-glass floating HUD, arcade drawer docks, tactile perk cards, and integrated monetization affordances.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Chivo / Barlow Condensed with tracking-tight and uppercase punch.
Stats, cooldown clocks, HP values, gold numbers MUST use monospace ('JetBrains Mono' / font-mono) to eliminate numerical jitter.
Headings capped at text-6xl. Labels and overlines must be tracking-[0.2em] and uppercase.
Forbidden color #7351B7 and forbidden dashboard teal (#1B93A4).
Base background is deep obsidian-zinc (#090d16 / #0f172a), never flat pure black #000000.
Glows: 1px subtle neon borders + drop-shadow / box-shadow tint instead of opaque heavy gradients.
Hover text color MUST ALWAYS be explicitly defined with hover:text-white / hover:text-cyan-300.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete HTML5 60fps canvas loop inside a responsive canvas manager with touch and mouse coordinate mapping.
Implement the 4 tower types with range rings, target acquisition (First / Lowest HP / Strongest), and projectile physics.
Hero unit can be relocated on canvas by right clicking or tap-to-move, and Hero has 3 click-to-cast tactical skills with cooldown overlays.
Implement the full wave engine: 20 progressive waves, creep paths with corners, health bars above creeps, and Boss encounter every 5 waves.

Build all 5 monetization placements: Sticky top & bottom ad banners, Second Chance revive modal, Roguelike perk card reroll via rewarded ad, 2x victory loot ad, and the Affiliate Offerwall Vault with SpawnTap Playtime SDK simulated iframe & live status pill.
Include full Web Audio API synthesis so sound effects work immediately with zero external mp3 asset failures.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements specified in this guideline.
Support offline persistence via localStorage (High score, Soul Gems, unlocked permanent talent upgrades, gold).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for modals, drawers or headers; always backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/90 with 1px border-cyan-500/30.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Use high contrast typography, crisp borders, neon glow pills, and responsive layout without generic centered layouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_touch: Ensure bottom tower drawer and HUD buttons are easily tappable on mobile screens (minimum 44px hitboxes).
